event.hall_dance_v2.0: There you are! I closed at five sharp tonight. No sense waiting for one more customer. They're all here!
event.hall_dance_v2.1: Checked the roof once. Twice. ...Three times, my father said. It's finished.
event.hall_dance_v2.2: Your planks are up there, every one. I've told the word "nearly" it can retire.
event.hall_dance_v2.3: Look at this room! Full, and the porch is full too. Somebody count the porch, I've lost track of my own party.
event.hall_dance_v2.4: [player]. You brought the wine, I brought the village. First glass is yours.
event.hall_dance_v2.5: Okay, okay, okay, the door. Did it squeak? It didn't squeak. Say it didn't squeak.
event.hall_dance_v2.6: The roof's done, the hall's open, and nobody asked for credit. I'm writing it on the slate anyway.
event.hall_dance_v2.8: Big room, new roof, and the finest fiddler in Wetherell. Also the only fiddler. The competition's thin.
event.hall_dance_v2.9: First verse, then I step off. I'm calm. I'm holding this fiddle like a hot loaf.
event.hall_dance_v2.10: {if choice:chorus.home}Home, home, wherever the lamp is on. ...Your turn, Wetherell.{else}{if choice:chorus.road}The road goes on, and the road comes home. ...Your turn, Wetherell.{else}There's always room, there's always room. ...Your turn, Wetherell.{/if}{/if}
event.hall_dance_v2.11: The whole hall sings the chorus. Piper has stopped playing, and nobody minds.
event.hall_dance_v2.12: Hm. Hm-hm. I know the tune. Say nothing.
event.hall_dance_v2.13: Hear that? Nobody's playing, and it's still going. ...That's a chorus.
event.hall_dance_v2.14: Four words, Bram. "I know the tune." Don't worry, I'll say nothing. I'll just tell everyone.
event.hall_dance_v2.15: The hall door hangs on hinges I made. My mark's on every pin, and it swings like it's showing off!
event.hall_dance_v2.16: First thing I've marked that doesn't live at the forge. Technically it moved out. Technically it's a door.
event.hall_dance_v2.18: Wren wanted the porch counted. Six out there, seven in here. Every account in Wetherell, open at once!
event.hall_dance_v2.19: The roof pool is closed! Six winters of coins, and Tilda picked the right year. She says it was skill.
event.hall_dance_v2.20: Hm. Four. Five. Somebody pay Wren.
event.hall_dance_v2.21: Into the hall box, all of it. Marcus, I've put you down for one dance. Collect it now.
event.hall_dance_v2.22: On the slate, then. I'll check the roof once more first. Three times, my father said.
event.hall_dance_v2.23: Collecting. One dance. Nobody tell the ladder.
event.hall_dance_v2.24: Marcus takes his one dance. Tilda counts the steps for him. The lamps burn low, and nobody goes home.
event.hall_dance_v2.25: I labeled the door. "Hall Door (Open)." First label I've ever made that I never want to change.
event.hall_dance_v2.26: This roof will outlive me. Tonight it only has to outlive the dancing.
event.hall_dance_v2.27: Last entry tonight, in the good chalk: "Opening night. Everyone came." That's the only total I ever wanted.
event.hall_dance_v2.28: Here's how I'll tell it: the whole village, one roof, nobody in a corner. {if choice:wren.bag.go}And one day I'll tell it somewhere with a sea.{else}{if choice:wren.bag.stay}And I'll tell it right here. I stayed for this.{else}You listened, so you hear it first. I won't even improve it. Much.{/if}{/if}
